source_table: 2021 G28 Number of Children Ever Born; females aged 15 and over
selection: Eight named states/territories; ages25–59 in seven five-year groups. Other Territories and other ages omitted. All selected groups have all eight source categories; no missing-cell filling.
definitions: Archive6 means6+ per G28 cell descriptors; blank parity is not stated. Counts are women, not children or families. Age is Census age, not age at birth.
limits: Historical cross-section, not cohort fertility or a causal estimate. Resident family size, fathers ages and job type are absent. ABS original agreement unverified; official download proxy403.
